observable_requests.affirmative_interpretation: The panel pairs one straight, oppositely extended two-lobed figure with one bent, elbow-shaped two-lobed figure; their corner and oblique-stroke organizations realize these two distinct angular forms.

panel_descriptions.neg_0: An upper compact crossed figure has two pointed triangular lobes, while a lower slender figure has two aligned diamond-shaped lobes.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: Two separated elbow-shaped figures each bend around a central junction and carry pointed enclosed lobes.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: A left figure joins a small diamond to a broad quadrilateral, while a right kinked figure joins a narrow triangular cell to a tapered quadrilateral cell.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: Two separated, straight hourglass-like figures each place elongated quadrilateral lobes on opposite sides of a central junction.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: An upper shallow crossed figure forms long pointed triangular wedges, while a lower straight figure consists of two aligned diamond lobes.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: An upper bent figure combines a narrow triangular cell with a rightward quadrilateral lobe; a lower diagonal figure combines two large quadrilateral cells at a junction.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: The upper figure is a straight diagonal chain of two quadrilateral loops; the lower figure is an elbowed chain of two enclosed angular loops.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: The upper-left figure bends sharply around its central junction, while the lower-right figure forms a straight vertical hourglass with two diamond loops.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: The upper-left figure is an elbowed two-loop chain, while the lower-right figure is a straight shallow-diagonal chain of two quadrilateral loops.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: The upper-left figure is a nearly straight vertical chain of two elongated loops; the lower-right figure bends at its central junction and carries an enclosed lobe along each arm.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: The left figure is a straight vertical chain of two narrow loops; the upper-right figure is a broad elbowed chain with two enclosed angular lobes.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: The upper-right figure is a straight diagonal chain of two diamond loops; the lower-left figure bends sharply and carries one enclosed loop along each arm.
